caption:
Can someone explain this? 😤

A hard inquiry sits on your report for 2 years.
But for FICO scores it generally only counts for the first 12 months.

So why does it feel like it follows you forever?

Did an inquiry ever make you hesitate to apply for something?
first_comment: What's the one application you put off because of an inquiry? 👇

instagram.first_comment: Tell us your inquiry story. @creditscoretruths reads every comment.

card.headline: Why does one inquiry stay on my report for 2 years?
card.sub: It generally only counts toward FICO scores for 12 months.
